free_tier.stated: 5 GB free (100 MB max file size, 1 GB/day bandwidth); 'Unlimited' storage/bandwidth/file-size starts at $12.95/month

egress.terms: Free plan is capped at 1 GB/day bandwidth — a hard daily meter, not a throttle. Paid Personal Unlimited claims 'Unlimited Storage, Bandwidth, File Size'.

tooling: Native rclone backend 'opendrive' (Tier 1); WebDAV at webdav.opendrive.com; documented REST API at opendrive.com/api.
chaining: 5 GB x unlimited accounts, but 1 GB/day egress per account means serving 1 TiB/day needs ~1000 accounts. Shard the serving layer, not just storage.
limits_note: 100 MB per file, 1 GB/day download, 200 KB/s on free. Hotlinking is offered as a feature but only meaningful with paid bandwidth.
